name: Hydrological Simulation Laboratory
description: Principles of hydrological modelling, components of hydrological models, conceptualization of mathematical hydrological models, distributed, semi-distributed, and lumped hydrological models, and conceptual, data-driven, and processes-based and physically based hydrological models. Hydro-meteorological, biophysical, and GIS data preprocessing. Hydrological model setup (GR4J, HBV, SWAT+, HEC-HMS, SWMM etc.) calibration and performance evaluation, performance evaluation metrics. Parameter sensitivity analysis, estimation, and uncertainty quantification. Modeling complex reservoir operations, land use and climate change.
